plugins.description: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine: deterministic pointer-template summaries with zero LLM calls, replacing the default LLM-summary compaction.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-codex

Codex 式换窗压缩引擎——彻底替换官方 dsh-compaction-basic 的「LLM 摘要式压缩」。

## 机制

- 继承官方 `BasicCompactionEngine`，只覆写官方承诺的唯一子类钩子 `summarize()`；
- 摘要改为**纯确定性指针模板（零 LLM 调用）**：归档声明 + 恢复通道指引（history_search / history_read / notes read）+ 最近 model 检查点笔记全文（读 `~/.dsh/context-budget/notes/<sid>.jsonl`，只读）+ 被归档区首尾消息截断锚点；
- SummaryResult 走官方契约的模板分支（无 `llmStreamCall` 字段，官方注释点名 "template, remote, or other summarizer"），转录中 `compaction/summary` 事件显示 `provider: template, model: codex-rollover`；
- shadow 事务、replay 定价、工具配对平衡、并发锁、阈值自动触发（0.8×窗口，router-standard 为 0.55）、context-overflow 恢复、/compact（compactNow）全部原样继承。

## 装配

- 源码：`~/.dsh/plugins-src/dsh-compaction-codex/`（本目录），构建：`bash scripts/build.sh`（链接 dsh-install 类型依赖 + tsc 编译 src → lib）；
- profile 链：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-compaction-codex` 软链 + `package.json` link 依赖（防 pnpm install 剪掉）；
- 预设：6 个用户预设（code / code-guarded / code-lean / dshagent / designharness / router-standard）compaction 组中 `compaction-basic` 条目已替换为 `compaction-codex`（2026-09-29，各文件留有 `.bak-20260929` 备份）；
- 生效范围：仅新会话（预设热扫描；运行中会话保持旧代装配）。

## 约束与边缘

- 官方 `summarizeCompaction` 要求摘要帧 token 数 < 被 shadow 内容 token 数；本模板上限约 5K 字符（约 1.5K tokens），对数千 tokens 以上的压缩区安全；极小压缩区会按官方逻辑抛错并留在日志（不会静默）；
- notes 文件缺失/损坏时自动降级（省略检查点段），不阻塞压缩事务；
- 回滚：预设 yml 中把 name 改回 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`（或恢复 .bak）即回官方 LLM 摘要，热生效（新会话）。

## 决策记录

- 2026-09-29 用户拍板：方案 A（子类替换）+ 纯 Codex 式（永不 LLM 摘要，无混合开关）；
- 否决方案 B（从零实现抽象 CompactionEngine：需重写 shadow 持久化/锁/配对平衡，收益零风险高）与方案 C（拆压缩组：长会话必撞上下文硬上限）。

plugins.description: 余额水桶：水位就是你的 DeepSeek API 余额，出水口流出的是正在花的钱。A bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent (DeepSeek Harness plugin).
plugins.readme_text:
# Balance Bucket · 余额水桶

**A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.**

![Six bucket states: full, pouring, low, refilled, unreadable, and dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket/v0.1.1/docs/images/bucket-states.png)

一只挂在窗口角落的小水桶。**水是你的余额，漏出去的是正在花的钱。**

Version 0.1.1.

## What it does

- **The water level is your real balance.** It reads `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with the same `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` that DSH chats with, so the bucket shows the money you actually have.
- **The water is two layers, because the money is.** Granted balance (赠送) floats on top of topped-up balance (充值). DeepSeek deducts the granted wallet first, so you watch the pale layer empty before the deep one moves.
- **The tap opens while money moves.** The stream and its droplets are proportional to the burn rate over the last three minutes — the tool for watching a `vibe coding` session eat your credit.
- **The bucket is as tall as the highest balance it has ever seen.** It starts full, and a top-up makes it taller rather than overflowing.
- **A failed read never lies.** If the balance cannot be read, the water stays where it was, the tap shuts, and the outline turns amber. It never empties the bucket to show an error.

Move it, resize it, tuck it away — right-click for settings, drag to reposition, arrow keys to nudge.

## Reading the bucket

| Look | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Pale layer on top | Granted balance (spent first) |
| Deep layer below | Topped-up balance |
| Blue water | Above 30% of the highest balance seen |
| Amber water | Between 10% and 30% |
| Red water, gentle wobble | Below 10% |
| Amber outline, no stream | The last read failed; the level is the last known one |
| Grey water, `—` | No API key configured, or the key was rejected |

Hover the bucket for the numbers, or open the settings panel for balance, granted/topped-up split, spent since start, added since start, burn rate, bucket size and the age of the last reading.

## Install

Package page: [dsh-plugin-token-bucket on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-token-bucket).

```text
dsh-plugin-token-bucket
```

Or pin this release:

```text
github:youchai2016/dsh-plugin-token-bucket#v0.1.0
```

The plugin needs the credential DSH already manages for chat. If the Models page has a working DeepSeek API key, the bucket works; if not, it says so instead of guessing.

## Privacy and runtime boundaries

- The API key is resolved through DSH's credential service on every poll and is **never** stored, logged, echoed in an error, or sent to the client half. The browser half never talks to the balance service itself.
- **One** outbound request exists: a read-only `GET` on the documented balance endpoint. No model calls, no telemetry, no listening port, no third-party service.
- Nothing about your conversations is read. This plugin subscribes to **no** session events, so it cannot see prompts, replies or tool output.
- Preferences and history live in the browser's local storage. The plugin never writes your DSH profile.

## Honest limits

- The burn rate is **estimated from balance deltas**, not from token counts: the balance moves in whole cents (¥0.01), so the reading is a rolling three-minute average rather than a per-request figure. It is deliberately not a billing statement.
- Polling is adaptive: every 5 seconds for two minutes after money moves, then 20 seconds, then once a minute while nothing happens. Change calls from other devices or tools are also visible, because they move the same balance.
- Prices, bonuses and the split between granted and topped-up balance are whatever the API reports. The bucket does not compute costs from a price list.
- Balances are read for one currency, preferring CNY.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
npm test
```

`preview/index.html` is a single offline file: open it in a browser, no server and no network needed. Its buttons fabricate balance samples, so every state can be inspected without an API key.

The Host half is bundled to `lib/index.js`, the strict browser/Host contract to `lib/remote.js`, and the browser half to `lib/client.js` by `pnpm run build`. Prebuilt files are committed so a Git install needs no build step.

## License

Code is [MIT](LICENSE). No third-party artwork is bundled: the bucket is drawn with CSS and one inline SVG.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把输入框模型选择器改成按来源渠道分块 + 下钻选模型，保留搜索与推理强度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-block-picker

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件 —— **按模型来源分块**的输入框模型选择器。

把官方那个「所有模型拉成一条长列表」的选择器，换成**先按来源渠道分块、再下钻进块内选模型**的两级结构；搜索、推理强度（Reasoning Effort）、模型可用性等原有能力**完全保留**。

---

## 效果

点击输入框右下角的模型位，弹出的不再是长长的平铺列表，而是**按来源分块的卡片网格**：

![分块面板与搜索、推理强度、速度与输出详略](docs/screenshot-panel.png)

- **① 全局搜索** —— 直接在顶部输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1`，跨全部来源聚合匹配；回车选中首项。
- **② 按来源分块** —— 每个渠道一张卡片，标出「N 个模型」与「进入 →」；卡片可拖动排序。
- **③「当前」标记** —— 正在使用的来源高亮描边 + 右上角蓝标。
- **④ 推理强度彩色滑条** —— 可拖动的 Low → Max 渐变滑条，点击刻度文字可直达。
- **⑤ 速度 / 输出详略** —— 当前模型支持时才出现，不支持则整行隐藏。

深色模式使用同一套主题 token，强调色为 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`），不再出现白底白字：

![深色模式下的分块面板](docs/screenshot-dark.png)

搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 打开**显示设置**，可按提供方整体开关，也可展开逐个开关模型：

![显示设置面板](docs/screenshot-settings.png)

触发按钮本身与同排的截图 / 麦克风图标保持同一设计语言（主题描边与文字）：

![输入框模型位与同排图标](docs/screenshot-composer.png)

---

## 功能

- **按来源分块**：DeepSeek 账号、DeepSeek API，以及 CodeBuddy / Qoder / TRAE 等第三方渠道，各自成为一张卡片；卡片上显示来源名、模型数量，当前所用来源带「当前」标记。
- **两级下钻**：点卡片 → 进入该渠道内只含它自己模型的列表；顶部 `← 所有来源` 或 `Esc` 返回。
- **全局搜索**：直接输入 `v3` / `sonnet` / `r1` 等关键词即可跨所有来源聚合匹配，回车选中首项；清空即回到分块视图。
- **推理强度（彩色滑条）**：当前模型支持 reasoning 时，浮层底部出现一条**可拖动的渐变色滑条**（Low → Max 分档，带发光 thumb），点击刻度文字也能直接跳档；右侧显示当前档位，`恢复模型默认` 一键回到提供方推荐值。
- **速度 / 输出详略自适应**：订阅类提供方（如 ChatGPT 订阅）的模型若支持 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity`，浮层底部会**额外出现对应的分段控件**；不支持的模型或提供方这两项**自动隐藏**，不会出现死开关。
- **显示设置面板**：搜索框左侧的 ⚙ 按钮打开设置，可**按提供方整体开关**、也可**展开逐个开关单个模型**是否出现在选择器里；顶部显示已隐藏数量，底部可一键恢复全部。
- **提供方拖拽排序**：卡片可直接拖动调整先后顺序（拖动时卡片半透明、目标位显示描边），松手即保存。
- **偏好持久化**：顺序、隐藏来源、隐藏模型全部写入 `localStorage`（key `dsh-model-block-picker.prefs.v1`），刷新与重启后保持；不存在的来源会在下次自动清理。
- **主题自适应**：浅色、深色均用 DSH 主题 token，深色下强调色使用 `--dsw-alias-link`（`#7aaaff`）而非会反转成近白的 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary`。

## 安装

### 从本机目录安装（开发 / 自用）

在 DSH 会话里对 Agent 说：

> 帮我安装位于 `<本仓库路径>` 的插件

Agent 会执行 `plugin_manager(action: 'install_bundle', target: '<绝对路径>')`。

安装后**彻底退出 DSH 桌面端再重新打开**（客户端 bundle 有启动基线缓存，仅刷新页面不一定加载新代码）。

卸载：`plugin_manager(action: 'remove_bundle', target: 'dsh-model-block-picker')`，回退到官方原生选择器。

## 它是怎么工作的

### 1. 覆盖官方选择器（Slot 影射）

输入框模型位是 DSH 公开的一个**命名插槽**：`conversation.input.model`（`kind: "single"`，会话作用域）。

- 官方实现注册在优先级 `-10`；
- 动态安装的插件注册同名插槽时，系统分配**更低的数值即更高优先级**获胜；
- 本插件显式注册 `priority: -20`，因此作为 winner 覆盖原生组件，卸载即自动回退。

> 注意：`single` 槽位要求同优先级唯一，所以必须用负数优先级，否则会抛
> `single slot already has a registration`。

### 2. 复用官方数据服务（不重复造轮子）

不自己请求后端。通过 `ctx.modelDirectories`：

```js
const directory = models.directoryFor(sessionId);
directory.store   // 快照：{ groups: [{ id, name, models: [...] }], current: { provider, model, reasoningEffort } }
directory.load()  // 拉取目录
directory.select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })  // 提交选择
```

与 `/model` 命令弹窗**共用同一份会话级目录**，任一入口的切换另一入口立即可见。

### 3. 深色外观的白，来自主题而不是硬编码

早期版本手写 `#1c1f23` 之类的兜底色，在深色下不会反转，导致字和箭头变深灰。现在全部改用真实 token：

| 用途 | token | 深色取值 |
|---|---|---|
| 主文本 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f9fafb`（off-white，非纯白） |
| 边框 | `--dsw-alias-border-l1` | `#ffffff0f` |
| 背景 | `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2`、`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay` | — |
| 品牌色 | `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | — |

深色下额外用 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 把触发按钮设为 `.5px` 描边 + 该 token，与右侧截图插件
（`color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)` + `fill:none stroke=currentColor stroke-width=1`）
保持同一笔画重量。

> **踩坑记录**：写 CSS 时**别凭印象编变量名**。DSH 里**不存在**
> `--dsw-alias-text-regular`、`--dsw-alias-border-subtle`、`--dsw-alias-surface-overlay`、
> `--dsw-alias-primary` 这些名字——它们会静默回落到你写的兜底值，浅色看着没事、深色就崩。
> 可用 `cordis_inspect_query(platform: 'client', provider: 'Theme', method: 'listTokens')` 查真实 token。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-model-block-picker/
├── package.json          # 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Loader patch：把本包插进 profile 名单
├── index.js              # 宿主半边（挂 /diag 诊断路由）
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：React 组件 + 样式 + 插槽注册
├── .github/workflows/
│   └── publish.yml       # 推 main 即发布 npm + 打 tag + 建 Release
├── scripts/
│   └── release-notes.mjs # 从 CHANGELOG 抽取当前版本的 Release 正文
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 诊断

排障时会用到：

- 宿主侧日志前缀 `[dsh-model-block-picker]`（DSH 日志里搜这个）。
- 浏览器端各生命周期节点会打到 `/plugins/dsh-model-block-picker/diag`：
  `module-evaluated` → `apply-called` → `slot-inject-triggered` → `registered-success`。
  若停在 `register-error`，说明槽位/优先级冲突；停在 `apply-error` 多半是 `inject` 未声明就访问了服务。

> **另一个坑**：客户端沙箱对服务访问有白名单。顶层 `inject` 声明了 `['slots','modelDirectories']`，
> 就**不能**再直接读 `ctx.sessions`，否则抛 `service "sessions" is not declared` 并当场崩溃。

## 已知限制

- 只替换输入框（composer）的模型位；`/model` 命令弹窗仍是官方样式（两者共用同一份数据，切换互通）。
- 已寻址的 subagent 会话不提供模型选择（沿用官方约定）。
- 来源分组顺序：默认 DeepSeek 账号 → DeepSeek 官方 → 其余按名称排；**可直接在面板里拖动卡片自定义顺序**，保存于 `localStorage`。
- 速度 / 输出详略依赖提供方暴露能力：目前只有实现了 `speedMode` / `outputVerbosity` 偏好的提供方（如 `dsh-codex-subscription` 的 `openai-codex`）会被识别；其他提供方这两项不显示。
- 偏好保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，因此**按浏览器 profile 隔离**，不随 DSH 账号同步。

## 发布流程

发版只有一步：**push 到 `main`**。

```bash
# 1. 改代码
# 2. 改 package.json 的 version
# 3. 在 CHANGELOG.md 加一个 ## [x.y.z] 段落
git push                     # ← 只有这一步会触发发布
```

`publish.yml` 随后依次完成：校验版本号 → 确认 npm 上还没有这个版本 → `npm publish`（带 provenance）→ 打 `vX.Y.Z` tag → 用 CHANGELOG 对应段落建 GitHub Release。

### 只有第一次需要手动配置

npm 那边要认这个仓库，得先建一次「信任关系」（之后永久有效）。

**前置条件：npm 账号必须已开启 2FA。** 未开启时 registry 直接拒绝可信发布器的读写（`403 Please enable 2fa for your account`），而且这个报错只在你尝试配置时出现，不会提前提示。2FA 用安全密钥（passkey / Windows Hello）或验证器 App 都行，等级选 `auth-and-writes`。

**方式一：命令行**

```bash
npm trust github dsh-model-block-picker \
  --file publish.yml \
  --repo liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker \
  --allow-publish
```

这是账号级写操作，会要求一次性口令：终端会打印一个 `https://www.npmjs.com/auth/cli/<id>` 链接（npm 11.19 起把链接里的 id 打码成了 `***`，看不到就改用下面的网页方式），在浏览器里用你的 2FA 完成验证即可。

**方式二：网页**

1. 打开 <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-block-picker/settings>，找到 **Trusted Publisher**。
2. 选 **GitHub Actions**，填三项（区分大小写，仓库和文件名都不能带路径）：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Organization or user | `liu19666` |
   | Repository | `dsh-model-block-picker` |
   | Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |

3. **Allowed actions 里勾上直接发布。** 2026-09-03 起新建的可信发布器默认只允许 `npm stage publish`（把包丢进待审队列，需要人手动 2FA 批准）。本仓库要的是无人值守直接发布，必须额外勾选 `npm publish`。漏了这一步，工作流会以 `403` 失败，而 npm 保存配置时**不会**校验这些字段，错误只会在发布那一刻才出现。
4. Environment name 留空——工作流没有声明 `environment`，填了反而对不上。

### 它不会踩的几个坑

- **不写死版本号。** 版本号的唯一来源是 `package.json`；`CHANGELOG` 段落只决定 Release 正文，漏写不会导致失败（会退回 GitHub 自动生成的 notes）。
- **幂等。** 每个 job 都先检查自己的产物是否已存在：版本已在 npm 上就跳过发布，tag 已存在就跳过 Release。所以重跑失败的任务、或者忘了改版本号又推一次，都不会重复发布，也不会有「版本号被占了但 tag 没打」这种半成品状态。
- **不需要任何 secret。** 认证走 GitHub OIDC：npm 验证的是「这个仓库、这个分支、这个工作流文件」签出的短期令牌，没有 `NPM_TOKEN` 可泄露，也无法从别人机器上重放。
- **发布前不做任何不可逆的事。** npm 版本号一旦发布就永久占用，所以版本格式、npm 是否已有该版本这些检查全在 `preflight` job 里跑完，`publish` 才会启动。
- **预发布版本不会顶掉 `latest`。** `1.2.0-beta.1` 会以 `beta` 这个 dist-tag 发布，Release 也标成 prerelease —— 否则 `npm install dsh-model-block-picker` 会给陌生人装上一个 beta。
- **`.npmrc` 里不留凭据。** `actions/setup-node` 一旦带 `registry-url`，就会往 `.npmrc` 写 `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`；可信发布场景下这个变量是故意不设的，展开成空串后 npm 会误以为「凭据已配置」，直接跳过 OIDC 交换并报 `ENEEDAUTH`（[npm/documentation#1960](https://github.com/npm/documentation/issues/1960)）。本工作流因此**不传** `registry-url`（npm 本来就默认官方源），并在发布前断言 `.npmrc` 里没有 `_authToken`，让失败指向真正的原因。

### 只想发一次 npm、不想建 Release

手动跑一次 `workflow_dispatch` 也行；或者反过来，用 `gh release create` 手工发版——工作流只认 `package.json` 的版本号，不关心是谁推的。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH chat zoom plugin / DeepSeek Harness 聊天缩放插件
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Chat Zoom · 缩放 **中文** | [English](#english) DeepSeek Harness（DSH）聊天区域缩放插件。仅缩放聊天消息和输入区，不改变侧栏、设置页或全局弹窗。 - 插件名称：**缩放** - 软件包 / 仓库名称：`dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` - 首个 GitHub 发布版本：**v0.1.0** - 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE) [下载 v0.1.0](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) · [报告问题](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/issues) 补充文档：[更新说明](CHANGELOG.md) · [脱敏验收记录](VALIDATION.md) · [隐私说明](PRIVACY.md) · [贡献与维护](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [市场投稿与合并注意事项](MARKET.md)。这些文档后补于 main；既有 v0.1.0 安装包与 tag 保持不变。市场 PR #7323 已合并；界面展示仍取决于后续采集，安装包仍为 v0.1.0。 **当前 main 开发版本：v0.3.2（尚未发布安装包）**。已接入自定义放大/缩小/复位键盘组合与独立滚轮修饰键（Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta）、原生设置、恢复默认与本地配置；默认仍为 Ctrl。下方下载和市场条目仍安装 v0.1.0，不包含本周开发更新；新能力当前仅在 main 源码中。 ## 简介与示例图（已发布 v0.1.0） **仅缩放 DSH 聊天消息和输入区（80%–200%），支持 Ctrl 快捷键、设置调节与本地记忆，不缩放侧栏。** 下图是用 **v0.1.0 原客户端**在合成示例页面中运行后截取的浏览器隔离演示，**不是 DSH 实机截图，也不证明宿主兼容性**。示例文字、侧栏和输入区均为合成内容，不包含用户会话；未展示 main 中尚未发布的自定义快捷键界面。市场图片由根目录 [screenshots.json](screenshots.json) 声明，需市场合并及采集后才可能显示，不保证立即出现。 **放大演示**：消息、代码、图示与输入区放大，示例侧栏及顶部尺寸不变。 ![150% 局部缩放隔离演示，非 DSH 实机截图](assets/chat-zoom-demo-150.png) **默认倍率对照**：使用同一演示布局，便于比较作用范围。 ![100% 默认倍率隔离演示，非 DSH 实机截图](assets/chat-zoom-demo-100.png) 图片依据原 v0.1.0 安装包（SHA-256：`908b0eca7bf91b4528a125f29b05a0590901ee29ad3fcb98f7afddb381510222`），使用 Chrome 155 无头浏览器、固定视口及示例输入事件生成；原客户端代码未修改。它们只展示已发布版本的局部缩放行为，不替代真实 DSH 验收。 ## 功能 - 文字、代码、图片和输入控件一起进行布局缩放。 - 默认 **100%**，范围 **80%–200%**；快捷键和放大 / 缩小按钮每次调整 **10 个百分点**。 - 在设置页选择倍率、放大、缩小、恢复默认或清除倍率记忆。 - 操作后显示倍率提示，最后一次操作 **5 秒**后自动隐藏；聊天区没有常驻缩放工具栏。 - 同一页面的聊天面板共用倍率；按浏览器的网站来源保存偏好，刷新后可恢复。 - 尽量保留当前阅读位置，不强制跳到聊天顶部或底部。 ## 运行要求 这是 **DSH 插件**，不是 Chrome / Edge 扩展，也不是可独立运行的网站。 需要提供客户端模块加载器、React 共享模块和 `settings.section` 插槽的 DSH，以及支持 CSS `zoom` 的浏览器。适配依据为 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 的内部聊天 DOM 属性；不保证其他宿主版本兼容。`v0.1.0` 是本插件的版本，不是 DSH 的版本。 发布包已包含可运行的客户端文件，**无需自行构建或安装独立 React**。插件界面目前使用中文；本文档提供中英双语说明。 ## 安装 ### 方法一：在 DSH 插件页安装（推荐） 1. 在 [v0.1.0 发布页](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载 **`dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz`**。不要把 GitHub 自动生成的源码 ZIP 当作插件安装包。 2. 打开 DSH 侧边栏的 **插件** 页面，进入安装外部插件 / 组合包的入口。 3. 将下载文件的**完整绝对路径**作为安装来源，例如：`C:/Downloads/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz`。这里的路径只是示例，请换成实际下载位置。该路径必须能被运行 DSH 的电脑访问；远程浏览器本地的文件不一定对 DSH 主机可见。 4. 确认安装，并检查 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` 已启用。若入口支持 HTTP(S) 压缩包来源，也可直接填写下方下载地址。 5. 刷新 DSH 页面，再打开 **设置 → 缩放**。如果仍不出现，请完整退出并重启 DSH，而不是只关闭网页。 安装包直链： ```text https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz ``` ### 方法二：使用 DSH CLI 如果已配置 `dsh` 命令，桌面版可运行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-plugin-chat-zoom@https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz" --ignore-scripts ``` 离线安装已下载的文件，例如在 Windows 上： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-plugin-chat-zoom@file:C:/Downloads/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom-0.1.0.tgz" --offline --ignore-scripts ``` 请把文件路径和 `desktop` 替换为实际下载位置与当前 profile（配置档案）。不确定 profile 或没有 `dsh` 命令时，使用插件页安装。**这些命令由用户执行，本仓库不会自动修改 DSH 配置。** 插件自身没有安装脚本。 ### 方法三：安装仓库目录 也可下载并解压 GitHub 源码，或克隆仓库，然后在 DSH 插件页将**包含 `package.json` 的目录绝对路径**作为安装来源。不要直接选择 `lib` 子目录。 ## 使用 ### 设置页 进入 **设置 → 缩放**： 以下设置说明对应当前 main，历史变更见[更新说明](CHANGELOG.md)；v0.1.0 安装包没有自定义键盘/滚轮分区。顶部标出“仅缩放聊天消息与输入区”，并显示当前倍率和范围。“选择倍率、缩小、放大”与“恢复 100%、清除倍率记忆”分组，下方另有真实可用的键盘表单和独立滚轮选择。均保留原生控件、换行与焦点样式；真实 DSH 窄屏布局和键盘操作尚未实机验收。 | 控件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 聊天倍率 | 选择 80%–200% 的倍率 | | 缩小 / 放大 | 每次调整 10 个百分点 | | 恢复 100% | 恢复默认倍率，并保存该值 | | 清除倍率记忆 | 恢复 100%，删除本插件保存的倍率记录 | | 保存快捷键 | 校验三个输入；有效时应用并尝试保存，未保存草稿不生效 | | 恢复默认快捷键 | 丢弃键盘草稿并恢复默认，仅删除键盘记录，不改倍率或滚轮 | | 滚轮修饰键 | 选择一个修饰键，立即应用并尝试保存 | | 恢复默认滚轮 | 恢复 Ctrl，仅删除滚轮记录，不改倍率、键盘或键盘草稿 | 倍率修改立即生效；自定义键盘输入需点击“保存快捷键”才生效。清除倍率记忆不会删除聊天、输入草稿、键盘/滚轮配置或其他设置；滚轮选择立即生效，无需“保存快捷键”。 当前 main 的设置底部显示初始倍率、操作完成或保存失败的状态。“恢复 100%”会保存 100%，即使当前已经是 100%；“清除倍率记忆”会恢复 100% 并删除记录，之后调整倍率或再次恢复会重新保存。无法保存/删除时会明确提示，而不声称记录已清除。存储键与格式不变。 设置使用原生键盘操作：`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 移动焦点，方向键选择倍率，`Enter` 或空格激活按钮；不依赖聊天缩放快捷键。main 的“恢复默认快捷键”只重置三个键盘绑定，不改变倍率。恢复/清除按钮关联同一段区别说明，底部状态使用礼貌播报。已完成模拟树与事件检查，真实 Tab 顺序、选择框在各浏览器的交互和屏幕阅读器效果仍需实机验收。 ### 快捷键（下表为默认绑定） 当前 main 的 **设置 → 缩放 → 键盘快捷键** 提供放大、缩小、复位三个输入框。输入组合后点击“保存快捷键”，例如分别设为 `Alt+J`、`Alt+K`、`F9`；只有保存后的绑定生效，新的键盘绑定替换而非叠加旧默认。滚轮独立配置，见下节；修改键盘不会改变滚轮。 - 使用单次组合，以 `+` 连接 `Ctrl` / `Alt` / `Shift` / `Meta` 与主键。主键支持 `Plus`（`+` / `=`）、`Minus`（`-`）、数字、A–Z 和 F2/F8/F9，但须通过下面的安全限制。`Control`、`Option`、`Cmd` / `Command` 分别是 Ctrl、Alt、Meta 的别名，修饰键顺序和字母大小写会归一化。 - 无修饰键或仅 Shift 时只允许 F2/F8/F9；字母仅允许含 Alt 且不含 Ctrl/Meta，保守拒绝 Alt+B/D/E/F/H/T 等菜单组合。Ctrl/Meta+数字 1–9、普通文字/编辑键、F1/F3/F4/F5/F11/F12、常见保留键、连续序列和重复绑定不可用。Ctrl/Meta+0 和符号键可用。Plus/Minus 忽略 Shift 差异，不能借此配置重叠动作；从 main v0.3.1 起，物理 Minus 键带 Shift 产生 `_` 时也匹配 Minus，其他键位的下划线不接管。其他修饰键必须准确匹配。示例不是跨系统无冲突保证。 - “恢复默认快捷键”丢弃输入草稿、恢复默认并删除仅此键盘配置，倍率不变；“清除倍率记忆”不清除快捷键。格式无效时不覆盖已有绑定；本地保存/删除失败时会说明仅本页生效，刷新可能恢复此前记录。不会接管 IME、AltGraph 或全局快捷键；被 OS/宿主先截获时改用其他绑定或倍率控件，插件不会重写宿主保留键。 ### 自定义滚轮（仅当前 main，未发布） 在 **设置 → 缩放 → 滚轮缩放** 选择一个修饰键：`Ctrl`（默认）、`Alt`、`Shift` 或 `Meta`（Windows 键 / macOS Command）。选择立即生效并尝试保存；鼠标位于聊天消息或输入区时，只按所选一个键滚轮向上放大、向下缩小。普通无修饰滚轮和叠加其他修饰键的滚轮不接管；相比旧默认规则，本版不再接管 Ctrl+Shift 滚轮。仍保持 90ms 同向节流、反向立即响应和 80%–200% 边界。 “恢复默认滚轮”恢复 Ctrl 并仅删除滚轮配置，不改倍率、键盘或未保存的键盘草稿；存储失败会提示本页有效、刷新可能回退。Shift 会占用该区域的横向滚动手势；Alt/Meta 可能被 OS/宿主先处理。插件不改写宿主保留操作，冲突时换键或用倍率控件。IME、AltGraph、弹窗与内嵌工具继续避让。触控板捏合报告为 Ctrl 滚轮时仍无法可靠区分；未选 Ctrl 时插件不接管此类事件，但浏览器可能自行处理。 **下表是当前 main 的默认绑定与作用范围，不是 v0.1.0 的完整行为说明。** v0.1.0 没有自定义配置；其焦点判定较宽，消息内普通按钮/链接聚焦也可能响应键盘缩放，且 Ctrl+Shift 滚轮也可缩放。main 的收窄规则没有回写到旧包。 | 操作 | 效果 | 使用位置 | | --- | --- | --- | | `Ctrl` + 滚轮向上 / 向下 | 放大 / 缩小 | 鼠标位于聊天消息或输入区 | | `Ctrl` + `+` / `-` | 放大 / 缩小 | 输入区有焦点；或没有其他控件焦点且鼠标悬停聊天区 | | `Ctrl` + `0` | 恢复 100% | 与上述键盘快捷键相同 | 加号支持 `Ctrl` + `=`、`Ctrl` + `Shift` + `=`；也支持小键盘加减号。普通滚轮与 `Ctrl+C/V/Z` 等编辑快捷键不会被接管。 从 main 的 v0.1.1 起，“输入区有焦点”仅指输入区内的多行文本框、文本输入框或可编辑文字区域。消息按钮、链接、发送按钮、文件选择、复选框、选择框等获得焦点时，不接管这些键盘缩放操作，即使鼠标仍在聊天区。无控件焦点时，必须仍悬停聊天区才响应。滚轮与设置控件的规则不变；插件不接管不代表浏览器或宿主也会忽略按键。 ## 隐私与卸载 插件自身不发送网络请求、不上传聊天、不收集遥测，不写服务端设置。v0.1.0 只保存倍率键 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:percent`；当前 main 另保存 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:keyboard`（版本号与三个绑定字符串）和 `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom:v1:wheel`（JSON：`{"version":1,"modifier":"Ctrl"}`，modifier 为所选单个修饰键），均位于当前浏览器来源的 localStorage。缺失/无效/未来键盘或滚轮配置使用默认，不迁走旧倍率或自动覆盖异常记录；不保存按键/滚轮事件日志，不跨设备/实时跨标签同步，也不按会话保存。 如需移除记录，main 中先点击 **设置 → 缩放 → 恢复默认快捷键** 和 **恢复默认滚轮**（分别只清除自己的配置），再点击 **清除倍率记忆**，检查状态无失败后再到插件页禁用或卸载；v0.1.0 只需清除倍率记忆。正常停用会移除插件自有监听器、倍率标记、提示和样式；可能需要刷新或重启。默认停用保留现存倍率、键盘和滚轮记录，**不要为了清理倍率而清空整个 localStorage**。 安装包的下载和 DSH 插件管理器自身可能使用网络；上面的隐私说明仅描述本插件运行时。 ## 已知限制与排查 - **设置中看不到“缩放”**：确认插件已安装并启用，刷新页面，必要时完整退出并重启 DSH。 - **所有网页元素一起放大**：可能是浏览器或桌面宿主先截获了快捷键。先用设置中的倍率控件；插件不能保证拦截宿主已处理的按键。 - **输入法或内嵌工具中不响应**：中文输入法组合输入、全局模态弹窗、聊天内嵌编辑器、终端和画布优先，插件有意避免抢占这些操作。 - **触控板捏合也触发缩放**：部分浏览器会将捏合报告为 `Ctrl` 滚轮，插件无法可靠区分。 - **升级 DSH 后不响应**：插件依赖宿主内部 DOM 属性，不匹配时不会对整个页面强制缩放；可能需要更新适配。 - **保存倍率失败**：浏览器可能限制本地存储，本次缩放仍可生效，但无法保证刷新后恢复。 当前开发检查涵盖模拟 DOM/虚拟 React、文档契约、JavaScript 语法、包内引用和模块注册；不代表已完成 DSH 实机、物理操作或真实输入法验证。浏览器支持 CSS zoom 不等于识别到了宿主聊天 DOM，设置可显示但区域不匹配时仍可能无效果；不会回退全页缩放。 ## 仓库内容与重新打包 本仓库包含插件文件、文档及无依赖的轻量回归测试，不包含私人聊天、缓存、安装配置备份或迁移工具。`lib/client.js` 为完整、可读的预构建客户端实现；本仓库未提供原始拆分源码和构建工具。 在 Node.js 24 上运行 `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`，执行 75 项模拟 DOM/虚拟 React/配置回归及 5 项文档契约检查，共 80 项通过。文档检查直接对照客户端默认值、存储 JSON、版本和相对链接；不验证真实 DSH。测试不随安装包分发，D5/D6 的实际证据与实机未测项见[脱敏验收记录](VALIDATION.md)。维护分区注释不是磁盘上的 src 文件；直接维护可读客户端，不运行不存在的生成器，见[贡献说明](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 | 文件 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `package.json` | 包版本、入口与 DSH 元数据 | | `index.js` | 宿主入口；功能在浏览器客户端运行 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH 插件注册配置 | | `lib/client.js` | 完整客户端逻辑与设置界面 | | `README.md` | 中英双语使用说明 | | `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 | 维护者可在仓库根目录使用 Node.js / npm 重新打包： ```sh npm pack --ignore-scripts ``` 生成的 `.tgz` 安装包不提交到源码仓库，而是上传到 GitHub Releases。发布包包含本文档和许可证，不包含 Git 元数据。 --- ## English **DSH Chat Zoom** changes the size of chat messages and the input area in **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It does not zoom the sidebar, settings pages, or global dialogs. - Display name: **缩放** (Zoom) - Package / repository: `dsh-plugin-chat-zoom` - First GitHub release: **v0.1.0** - License: [MIT](LICENSE) [Download v0.1.0](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom/releases/tag/v0.1.0) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/YangShen-SWE/

plugins.description: Offline HAR diagnostics with minimal evidence for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# HAR Triage

Offline network evidence for DeepSeek Harness. Find failed and slow browser requests without handing the agent your URLs, cookies or response bodies.

浏览器网络排障插件：读取本地 HAR，生成可回查原始请求索引的离线诊断报告。默认不把网址、请求头、Cookie、参数值或正文带进报告和 AI 工具结果。

![Synthetic HAR diagnosis: signals, source indexes and timing evidence](docs/report-demo.jpg)

The screenshot uses the bundled synthetic scenario, not real browser traffic.

## What it does

- Reads an existing HAR 1.2 capture; never records traffic, sends requests, or changes the capture.
- Groups requests into endpoint aliases, highlights HTTP 4xx/5xx, unavailable responses, slow requests and long waiting phases.
- Produces a self-contained HTML report: signals → request row → measured timing phases. Filters, pagination and source locators work offline.
- Returns at most 20 evidence entries to the agent, with a count of omitted evidence. The full numeric projection stays in the local JSON/HTML files.

Request #43 corresponds to `log.entries[42]` in your original HAR. Endpoint aliases deliberately do not reveal names. Keep the original capture private and use its index to look up the actual request locally.

## Install in Harness

Node 22.19+ is required. Install the prebuilt bundle into your chosen profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-har-triage/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-har-triage-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile YOUR_PROFILE --dump-config
```

The configuration should contain the `har-triage` row. Start that profile, put your HAR inside its session workspace, and ask:

> Inspect capture.har with har_triage. Save reports in a new har-review directory. Explain the measured evidence and cite the original HAR entry indexes. Do not guess root causes.

Tool arguments:

```json
{"input":"capture.har","outputDir":"har-review","slowMs":2000}
```

The tool uses Harness filesystem and sandbox services. It requires write permission to create the reports and refuses input/output paths outside the session workspace. Existing report files are never overwritten. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-har-triage`.

## Try without Harness

The CLI and analysis/report modules use Node built-ins only. From a source checkout:

```sh
node src/cli.js capture.har --out new-report-directory --slow-ms 2000
```

Open `new-report-directory/report.html`. The output directory must not exist. The original capture is unchanged.

For a reproducible synthetic example:

```sh
npm run demo
```

This creates a new directory under `artifacts/` with a deliberately synthetic capture and its report. It is not evidence of real browser traffic or real users.

## Evidence, not root-cause claims

`503` means the capture records a server-error response. `status: 0` means it did not record a valid HTTP response. Neither identifies a failing service, proves CORS, or proves an expired token. A high wait/TTFB share is an observation, not proof that the backend or database is slow.

Start offsets include submillisecond differences and are expressed in relative milliseconds. Absolute source timestamps are never included in the report.

Unknown phase timings and byte sizes remain `-1`, displayed as “Unknown.” TLS is part of the HAR connection timing and is not added a second time. Contradictory phase durations are flagged; the report hides misleading proportions.

Ollama's [`application/x-ndjson` streaming responses](https://docs.ollama.com/api/streaming) are classified as JSON. This is a MIME-based content category, not validation of the response body; model output remains excluded from reports.

## What is retained and removed

Retained: source entry index, sequential endpoint alias, controlled method/status/content classes, relative offsets, numeric durations/sizes, and fixed diagnostic codes. Aliases group the same method/origin/path within one capture; query strings and fragments do not affect grouping.

HTTP method identity is case-sensitive: `GET` and `get` receive separate aliases. Only the allowlisted uppercase methods receive named display values; all other method tokens appear as `OTHER`. Private method tokens are used only for grouping and are not included in reports, tool evidence or report ID hashes.

Removed: complete URLs including origins and paths, query values, headers, cookies, request/response bodies, page titles, initiator data, IP addresses, absolute timestamps, extension fields, raw error text, and the original file digest. The report ID hashes only the retained projection. Arbitrary source strings are not copied to reports or tool evidence.

This is a minimal diagnostic projection, **not** a scrubbed HAR, an anonymization guarantee, or a replacement for reviewing an artifact before sharing it. Status patterns, sizes, timing, request counts and grouping can still identify an application. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Limits

- HAR JSON only: version `1.2`, UTF-8, at most 16 MiB and 10,000 entries. Invalid supported entries fail with fixed errors rather than silently truncating the evidence.
- HTTP and HTTPS requests are analyzed. Other protocols are excluded and counted. Missing timing/size values are retained as unknown; a valid request URL, start timestamp, duration, status and response content object are required.
- Synchronous bounded analysis: cancellation is checked before parsing and between entries, not an interruptible worker. The slow threshold defaults to 2,000 ms and is configurable per call.
- Reports are created exclusively. If HTML creation fails after JSON creation, the JSON is retained and the tool reports the partial result; retry using a fresh destination.
- No upload, traffic replay, header inspection, body analysis, automatic source lookup, or edits to the original HAR.

## Development and validation

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

48 tests passed on Node 24 and 26. They cover actual CLI subprocesses, controlled output and failure text, input limits, phases, original-file preservation, and real Cordis tool dispatch/filesystem/sandbox/Loader integration. `smoke:host` is a real service composition, not a CLI profile boot or a live-LLM test.

The packed bundle was separately installed through the actual CLI into fresh temporary Profiles on Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, then booted with `runProfile` and exercised through `har_triage`. Source bytes were unchanged; output omitted the synthetic canary; overwrite and workspace-escape attempts were refused. HMR was disabled only in those temporary Profiles. The alpha host emitted three unrelated Typert activation warnings; rc.2 did not. No LLM or real credentials were used.

Browser checks covered status filtering, signal-to-request navigation, correct source locators, no console errors, and a 390-pixel layout without page-level overflow. The demo and regression captures are synthetic; real-user usefulness is not yet validated.

## Related tools

[net-debug](https://github.com/JohnXu22786/net-debug) is an existing Harness HTTP client with history, replay and HAR export. [harlite](https://github.com/brucehart/harlite) already offers extensive HAR analysis, SQL, waterfall and HTML reporting. This plugin does not replace those tools: its narrower purpose is a Harness-native, no-external-binary, allowlisted evidence path for agent-assisted debugging.

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Mark things on a picture and look at the picture: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns an image into a record of numbered marks, with coordinate-labelled close-ups and comparison sheets you can check.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-reasoner

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets a model put numbered marks on a picture and
look at what it drew. A place is named in the picture's own pixels, read off a
labelled grid, so nothing is converted from a preview and no call has to be
expressed in the terms of an earlier one. It is not specific to any kind of
picture: counting the people in a photograph is one use, checking which of two
similar regions a note meant is another.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `camera_reset` | Point the camera at the whole picture — one square window holding all of it, the picture drawn inside and the rest black — and see it. |
| `camera_move` | `step: "next"` walks the sweep in reading order, `"previous"` steps back, a direction steps one whole window, and `to: [x, y]` centres the window on a place read off the grid. |
| `camera_zoom_in` / `camera_zoom_out` | One ×2 or ÷2 step each, about the centre, `times` for several at once. The camera stays where it is left. |
| `mark_add` | Mark places by their coordinates, `at: [x, y]` in original pixels, with a radius `r`, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to the batch and the answer is a window around it. |
| `mark_remove` | Delete marks by number, e.g. `[3, 7]`, when a mark is in the wrong place. |
| `mark_edit` | Move, resize, recaption or recolour marks by number, in one call. |

Every picture comes back with a grid whose lines sit at round positions in the
picture's own pixels — 100, 200, 500, depending on how closely it is being looked
at — and every line is labelled with that number along all four edges. A number the
model reads is a number it can use. Every result also lists the whole record, with
the coordinates of every mark, so a mark placed twice, or in the wrong spot, is
visible in the next answer rather than several calls later. The tools never count
or judge what is in a picture: that is the model's statement to make.

The package also publishes a skill, `vision-sweep-count`: the workflow this tool set was
built around — see the whole picture, sweep it window by window, mark as you read, read the
window that comes back, count the record. A model reads a skill when a task matches one, which
matters here because pointing inside reasoning is a mode a model does not enter on its own.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-vision-reasoner
```

Or from the Web UI: **Plugins → Add plugin**, with the package name. The package
declares `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml` (one Host row), which the
profile loader applies the next time the profile loads. There is no build step and
no install script.

The only dependency is [`sharp`](https://sharp.pixelplumbing.com/) (Apache-2.0),
which the harness already uses for every image a session attaches
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` depends on it), so a deployment that can run
this plugin already has it. Nothing third-party is vendored: the icon and the two
locale files are this package's own. Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

## How it is used

1. **Look first.** A place is named from what has been seen, and the tool
   descriptions say so before anything else. The grid on the returned picture is
   the only ruler: the picture is not cropped with another tool, and no position is
   read off another view of it, whose pixels are a different size.
2. **Read the labels.** The lines are at round numbers of original pixels, so a
   position is read by naming the line before a feature and estimating the gap —
   about a quarter of a step is as fine as the eye goes, which is why the grid steps
   finer as the view gets closer.
3. **Mark the coordinates.** `mark_add` takes `at: [x, y]`, a radius `r` in the
   picture's own pixels, a caption and a colour. The camera moves to what was marked
   and the answer is a square window around those marks, with a cross at each centre
   and the record beside it.
4. **Sweep in windows you keep.** `camera_zoom_in` until a face is big enough to read,
   then walk the picture with `camera_move` and `step: "next"`: the windows tile the
   picture from its centre, "next" goes left to right and then down, and every result
   says how far the sweep has got and which windows are left. A place read in a window
   already used is comparable with the last one.
5. **Check, then correct.** The marks are drawn in every view, so what is left unmarked
   in the window in front of you is what you have not dealt with, and the record beside
   it shows a number twice or a ring on nothing. `mark_edit` moves a mark that is nearly
   right and `mark_remove` deletes one that is not — at once, since a change comes back
   as a window around what it touched and a wrong ring misleads every view after it.

## Behaviour

**The record is not written to disk.** Marks live in the session log. The harness
logs every tool call with its arguments and its result, and the record is a fold of
those events, rebuilt with the same pure functions the live call used. A call
carries everything the fold needs — a place is a pair of pixels, a radius is a number
of pixels, and the camera is a list of ways it was aimed — so a reopened session recovers the
same record, and nothing appears beside your picture.

**Each picture is written twice.** The model receives an image block through the
attachment service, the shape `read_image` sends, so the picture arrives with the
call that drew it. The Web UI's preview needs a file, because it decides how to
render a document from its extension and an attachment object has none; the PNG is
therefore also written to `<cwd>/.dsh-vision/<name>.png` and reported
workspace-relative in `images[].path`. That directory is the only thing this plugin
writes, and only when there is a picture to show.

**A missing picture is reported, not thrown.** No attachment service, or a model
that does not declare image input (the gate `read_image` applies), returns the text
plus a note instead of an image block; so does a failed write. Anything merely
unknown — an unresolvable route, an adapter error — attaches anyway, because
withholding a picture over a failed lookup costs more than it protects.

**Pictures are read through `ctx.fs`**, so the sandbox decides what may be read.

## The grid

- Lines sit at multiples of a round step — 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 … — chosen as
  the coarsest step whose labels are still about 100 view pixels apart. A wide view
  and a close view therefore both stay readable, and neither changes what a number
  means.
- Every label is an original-image coordinate, on all four edges, whatever the view
  is. Nothing is scaled, and nothing has to be converted.
- Lines are drawn 2 pixels wide at minimum and scale with the view, because a
  one-pixel line is gone by the time the attachment pipeline has re-encoded the
  picture.
- Every view is rendered at the same longest side, so looking at a rectangle is
  never coarser than looking at the whole picture.
- The camera is a place, not an action. A look shows what is in front of the lens, `zoom` and
  `move` aim it, `reset` points it back at the whole picture, and every result says where it is —
  so a caller reads "closer, a little left" rather than inventing rectangles, and looking again
  needs no arguments at all.
- Marks are drawn by default, so the picture carries the record; `marks: false` gives a clean
  canvas for counting a place again from scratch.
- Every result counts the windows the camera has **stopped in** since the last reset, names the
  one it is in, and names the ones still left: an unswept corner is a word in the answer rather
  than something a caller has to keep in its head.
- The window line says how the drawing relates to the picture — `drawn 1400x1400 (1.08x of the
  picture)` — because a caller that reads the rendering as the picture itself is wrong by exactly
  that ratio. One session reported reading a "1540x1084 preview" while every number it had was
  in a 2600-pixel space, and concluded the mapping was ambiguous.
- Every view is the same shape: a 1400x1400 square. The picture is placed inside it at the scale
  that fits and whatever is left over is black, so no view can come back as a strip one face

# dsh-locale-ja [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) A Japanese language plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI. ## Features - Translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese. - Uses Japanese-friendly fallback fonts while respecting your font settings. - Requests Japanese AI replies when Japanese is explicitly selected. You can still ask for another reply language. ## Compatibility Use this plugin with DSH's Web UI. Choose a compatible tag from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja/releases); supported DSH versions and changes are recorded there and in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## Installation Git and GitHub authentication with access to this private repository are required. Replace `` with your selected release tag. Prebuilt files are included; no local build is needed. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja.git#' dsh web ``` These commands use the `web` profile. Omitting the tag installs `main`, which may contain unreleased changes. To update, run the same `add` command with the new release tag and restart `dsh web`. It replaces the installed version; you do not need to remove it first. To remove: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @so16tm/dsh-locale-ja ``` Restart DSH after removal. ## Usage Choose **日本語** in **Settings → General → Language**. The reply-language instruction takes effect on the next reply. The instruction requires an explicit Japanese selection saved on the DSH host. It is not added when the language is chosen automatically by the browser or the host cannot save the selection, such as when accessing DSH from another PC on the LAN. Explicit requests for another reply language take precedence. ## Configuration To disable the reply-language instruction, add this entry to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: so16tm-locale-ja config: replyInUiLanguage: false ``` ## Limitations - Remove any other Japanese language plugin before enabling this one. - Newly introduced DSH strings may remain in English until translations are added. ## Development ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm check ``` `pnpm check` runs type checking, the build, tests, translation coverage, and release-note validation. Follow the [translation guide](docs/translation-guide.md) when editing translations. The [DSH update workflow](.claude/skills/dsh-update/SKILL.md) (Japanese) covers extracting source strings, applying translations, checking compatibility, and releasing. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) (Japanese) for design constraints. Commit the generated `lib/` files with source or translation changes. Update both READMEs when usage changes; record release-specific information in CHANGELOG.md. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Referenced projects are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: DSH 插件合集（聚合包）：一次安装把多个独立维护的 DSH 插件装配成一组，单个插件故障不影响其余功能。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-suite

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件合集 —— **聚合包**，一次安装即装配整套插件。

## 包含的插件

| 插件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [`dsh-lock`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-lock) | 密码门禁：打开 DSH 需输入密码解锁，支持手动/自动锁定 |
| [`dsh-settings-params`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-settings-params) | 设置分页：集中管理注入宿主的环境变量 |
| [`dsh-env-inspector-plus`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-env-inspector-plus) | 设置分页：宿主进程身份与环境变量分组概览（值不出宿主） |
| [`dsh-restart-autostart`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-restart-autostart) | 进程控制：重启按钮 +「跟随系统启动」 |
| [`dsh-archive-session-manager`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-archive-session-manager) | 归档会话管理 |
| [`dsh-sidebar-tab-actions`](https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-sidebar-tab-actions) | 右侧栏标签页右键菜单：关闭左侧 / 关闭右侧 / 关闭全部 |

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-suite
```

装完后在「设置 → 插件」里会看到 **dsh-plugin-suite** 一个分组，展开即本包装配的全部插件。
若想单独安装某个插件，直接装它自己的仓库即可（本包不强制）。

> ⚠️ **请用 npm 包名安装，不要用 `github:` 规格。**
> 原因：pnpm 对 `github:` tarball 依赖**不解析其 `dependencies`**（lockfile 的
> `snapshots` 段不记录依赖关系），结果就是**子插件根本不会被安装** ——
> `node_modules` 里只会有本包自己。只有走 npm registry 时依赖才会被正确解析。
> 这条是实测结论，不是推测。

## 这是什么形态：聚合包，不是「合并代码」

本包 **不含任何功能代码**（`lib/index.js` 只有一行 `export {}`），它的全部内容是一份
`cordis.patch.yml`，用一个 `cordis:group` 行把下面列表里的独立插件装配成一组。

这样做的理由：

| | 聚合包（本仓库） | 把代码合并进一个包 |
|---|---|---|
| 功能代码 | 仍在各自仓库，独立发版 | 全部挤在一处 |
| **故障隔离** | ✅ 单个插件出错只影响自己那一行 | ❌ 任一处出错**全部功能一起失效** |
| 独立升级 | ✅ 各包单独发版，本包无需改动 | ❌ 不可能 |
| 排障 | ✅ 定位到具体插件 | ❌ 混杂在一起 |

故障隔离这一点有实测依据：平台的行是独立加载的，而**一个插件的 `apply` 抛错会导致它自己激活失败**。若各份代码合并在同一包里，同一类错误会一次拖垮全部功能——包括锁屏。

> 另有一条平台硬约束：客户端 bundle 的 `id` 必须等于包名。各插件的客户端半身各有自己的 id，物理上无法合并进同一个 bundle。

## 自定义

想增删组合里的插件，直接改 `cordis.patch.yml` 的嵌套列表；每个条目的：

- `id`：本组合内的短名，仅用于定位与在其他 patch 层里覆盖它；
- `name`：**必须是真实包名**，且要在 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里声明。

## 许可证

MIT

# dsh-butler

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-butler` is the Butler plugin for the DSH App, shipping its browser UI and local host in one package. The host registers routes, scans extensions, and manages processes through DSH's `webServer` and `subprocess` services. It does not start a standalone Guardian, install a LaunchAgent, or depend on Nowledge Mem.

## DSH compatibility

The compatibility declaration is limited to DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2**. Both `engines.dsh` and the optional peer `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` use exactly `0.2.0-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.2`; the optional peer describes the host without installing another DSH runtime. It does not claim compatibility with later prereleases. Recheck Host services, session events, and Client Slots after a DSH upgrade; metadata and local tests do not replace live App acceptance.

## Working directory

Plugin configuration accepts `workdir`, defaulting to `~/.dsh/butler/`. On first load, the plugin copies its built-in generic skeleton; a directory that already contains `butler.json` is not overwritten. Personal data, interpreter configuration, and extensions belong to the instance working directory and can be migrated together. The plugin does not assume a personal workspace.

Example root configuration for the working directory:

```json
{
  "scanRoots": ["tools", "services", "faculties"],
  "selfRoot": "self",
  "validityRoot": ".",
  "python": "/path/to/python",
  "bun": "/opt/homebrew/bin/bun",
  "notification": {
    "enabled": true,
    "command": ["bun", "notification-bridge/scripts/cli.js", "send", "--stdin"]
  },
  "endpoints": {},
  "collector": { "enabled": true, "workspaces": [], "excludePresets": ["butler"], "debounceMs": 2000 },
  "automations": {}
}
```

Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing `butler.json`. Extensions under `tools/` and `services/` with `hosted.autoStart` resume when the DSH App starts; DSH's subprocess managed range terminates them when the App exits or the plugin unloads. Services do not restart automatically; tools restart inside the host according to their manifest policy. Bounded commands and reports from `faculties/` also run through the same subprocess integration.

## Host API

Public Host APIs share DSH's same-origin prefix `/myspace-butler/api`; the original client paths `/myspace-butler/*` remain compatibility aliases. Routes include `/health`, `/catalog`, `/services`, `/faculties`, `/runs`, and `/quick-actions`; tool lists come from `/overview`. Both tools and services support `/:kind/:id/{start,stop,restart}` and `/:kind/:id/log` SSE. Requests accept only local same-origin browser traffic or local SDK calls. The public extension catalog excludes commands and environment variables; configuration-editing endpoints are for trusted local calls only. See [HOST.md](<HOST.md>) for the complete routes.

Extensions use a `butler.json` in each directory; see [the schema](<spec/butler.schema.json>) for all fields. The SDK runner sends events using `BUTLER_HOST_URL`; `BUTLER_GUARDIAN_URL` is only a compatibility alias for old extensions, not a new configuration entry point.

**Delegations:** tools/services may declare steps requiring judgment in their manifests. The Host delegates them to a new Butler Session (`POST /delegations`, blocking until submission, timeout, or failure). Only the Host drives sessions: it creates a butler-preset session with `sessionController.create`, delivers a `prompt` using the delegation ID as requestId, and calls `cancel` on timeout. The session may use only the declared tools and `butler_delegation_submit`; results are validated against the declared schema. Results with `risk: confirm` remain pending in the observation area. `POST /runs/:runId/steps/:i/confirm` uses the same owner-only gate as card review (`X-Butler-Review` plus same-origin Origin or authenticated desktop forwarding). If DSH does not provide `sessionController.prompt`, `/delegations` returns 503 and callers use their own fallback. See [the SDK README](<sdk/README.md>) for usage.

## Unified MCP service (Butler Framework MCP standard)

Three layers communicate only through manifests and the MCP protocol:

| Layer | Responsibility | Exclusions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Framework (`spec/butler.schema.json`) | Defines the `mcp` registration block: `transport: "stdio"`, `command`, optional `cwd/env/namespace/timeoutSec`; tools/services only | No independently exposed `http`/`url` forms |
| Host (`src/host/mcp-hub.ts`) | Derives providers from scan results without a second registry; starts stdio subprocesses through `Spawner` on demand; aggregates as `<namespace>__<tool>`; serves stateless Streamable HTTP at `/myspace-butler/api/mcp`; adds/removes providers on rescan and restarts them when idle; terminates with the managed range on App exit | Does not import extension code or interpret business parameters |
| Extension | Implements a stdio MCP server | Does not listen on an MCP port or call Host internals; may reject direct client connections using `BUTLER_MCP_CHANNEL=butler-hub` |

Clients configure just one address: `http://127.0.0.1:19387/myspace-butler/api/mcp` (the desktop profile's App port). `GET /api/mcp/status` reports provider status, exposed tool names, namespace conflicts, and rejected tool names. The default namespace replaces `-` in the ID with `_`; exposed names must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`. Nonmatching tools are not exposed and appear in status. A provider crash affects only that provider: calls return an `isError` result and startup is retried after 5 seconds, without affecting other providers. The security boundary matches other Host APIs: loopback only, rejecting cross-site Origins (the DNS rebinding protection required by MCP).

**Unified MCP service:** tools/services in Butler that provide MCP declare only an `mcp` block (`transport:"stdio"` plus `command`). The Host lazily starts and aggregates them, exposing `POST /myspace-butler/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) with tool names `<namespace>__<tool>`. **Tools must not expose their own MCP listener or register directly with any client.** The Host does not import tool code; tools depend only on stdio MCP and the `BUTLER_MCP_CHANNEL` environment marker. The manifest contract is the sole connection between them. Clients register only `http://127.0.0.1:19387/myspace-butler/api/mcp`; status is at `/api/mcp/status`. See [HOST.md](<HOST.md#mcp-统一服务>).

## Dashboard display preferences

Services and tools each retain a “Show all / Show resident” mode. The heading arrow switches the display scope rather than collapsing the whole section. “Display management · N stored” is a single entry opening a drawer with all items. There you can mark items resident, operate them directly, and save or cancel display changes; card menus can also store individual items or mark them resident.

Storing an item is exclusively a manual choice, not inferred from autoStart, running state, or usage frequency; it does not change manifests or start/stop processes. Newly registered items are resident by default. Search always covers names, IDs, and descriptions of all items, marking matching stored items. Clearing search restores the previous mode. Sorting is disabled when some items are hidden or a search is active; showing all enables sorting.

Preferences use the Host's existing `layout.json` (version 1, adding optional `display.services/tools: { mode: 'all' | 'resident', stored: string[] }`), remaining compatible with old files. The page and sidebar share them, and they survive refreshes. “Reset order” clears only `order`, not display preferences. A failed save rolls back the display while retaining the drawer draft; older polling results do not overwrite newly saved settings.

## Development and verification

The full test suite includes maintainer-workspace fixtures, historical Git objects, and desktop integration checks; it is not a standalone-install smoke test. The portable CI slice after building is `bun test ./tests/build-launcher.test.ts ./tests/record-ref.test.ts ./tests/pipeline-agent-tools.test.ts`. Passing this slice does not establish full-suite or live-desktop acceptance.
